0022600120.text: The Cavaliers (1-1, third in the Central and one game back, ninth in the East) host the Timberwolves (3-0, third in the Northwest and sixth in the West), who are on a three-game winning streak. Cleveland is 1-0 at home and enters on a one-game win streak, while Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not met yet this season, and the Cavaliers won their last meeting 146-134 in Cleveland on January 10, 2026.
